summary.text: Nelson Abbott is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 57, where he has served since 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
An attorney, he earned his bachelor's and law degrees from Brigham Young University.

paragraphs.text: Abbott was born in Escondido, California, and earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1989 and a J.D. from BYU in 1993.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Abbott has served in the Utah House since 2021 and was vice chair of the Government Operations Committee in 2023-2024.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he said he would oppose unnecessary tax increases and described supporting the Second Amendment and the right to life as priorities.
